description: Defines an abstract class 'ThickThinBarCode' for rendering barcode types with thick and thin lines, including rendering logic, ratio management, and orientation handling.

classes.name: ThickThinBarCode
classes.description: Abstract base class for barcode types with thick and thin lines, providing rendering and ratio management.

methods.name: InitRendering
methods.description: Initializes rendering settings, calculates bar width, and applies orientation transforms.

methods.name: RenderBar
methods.description: Renders a single bar (thick or thin) in the barcode.

methods.name: RenderTurboBit
methods.description: Renders a thick bar before or after the barcode, used for special barcode features.

methods.name: RenderText
methods.description: Renders the barcode text at specified position relative to the bars.

methods.name: GetBarWidth
methods.description: Calculates width of thick or thin bars based on ratio.

methods.name: CalcThinBarWidth
methods.description: Abstract method to calculate the width of thin bars, to be implemented in subclasses.
